title: A gold breakout made 40% over five years before costs and lost 54% after them
author: person-person12
selftext:
I took a plain 20 candle breakout that roughly broke even on NQ and ran the exact same rules on gold futures, 15 minute candles, January 2021 to the end of September 2026, $100k, one contract, not a single setting changed.

Before costs it was up 39.8%. After commissions and slippage on every entry and exit it finished at $46,252, **down 53.75%**, with an 84% max drawdown along the way.

The bill was $93,550 across 3,742 trades, about $25 a round trip. $25 is easy to ignore on one trade, and 3,742 of them ate the whole edge plus half the account, because a strategy that wins 36% of the time and trades several times a day runs on very thin margins.

The equity curve is rough too. It bled from $100k down to about $16k by January 2025, then gold went on its run and the account climbed back to $138k by March 2026 before handing most of it back to $46k by the end of September. Someone who started it in January 2025 would have watched it more than double in fourteen months.

I ran it in [Agenticks](https://www.agenticks.ca/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=autopilot&utm_content=ai_trading) with the cost model left on realistic, which is the default, and the gross figure is the same trades with the bill added back rather than a separate run. The same rules over the same window ended +8.5% on ES and +19.6% on NQ, net of their own costs.
